status_definitions.implemented: Available in the repository with code, tests and documented limitations.
status_definitions.experimental: Implemented but explicitly experimental or limited; claims must retain that qualification.
status_definitions.simulated: Shown only in a scripted or synthetic demonstration; not evidence of real-world performance.
status_definitions.externally_unverified: Requires independent review, external users, real deployments or other evidence unavailable locally.

compliance.certification.basis: No independent certification or legal review is present.

research.general_effectiveness.basis: Available decision and agent results are synthetic or scripted local experiments.

security.independent_review.basis: No commissioned independent human security review is recorded.

product.market_demand.basis: No representative buyer interviews or pilot demand evidence is recorded.
